01 / The study

Help make healthy
eating more personal.

Life after cancer can bring different dietary needs. Your perspective can help us understand how a digital tool fits into that experience.

This research study is designed to better understand how cancer survivors interact with a digital health tool and to collect information that will inform its development.

The tool being evaluated, ThriveWell, is a recipe generator that provides personalized recipes aligned with cancer prevention guidelines.

Get to know ThriveWell

A little more support.
A lot more you.

Many cancer survivors face challenges related to symptom management, budget constraints, flavor preferences, and other dietary needs.

ThriveWell is designed to find recipes that align with cancer prevention guidelines while tailoring recommendations to your specific needs and preferences.

◎ Access it through a web browser, including Safari, Chrome, or Firefox.

02 / What to expect

A conversation that
can make a difference.

If you agree to participate and are eligible, you’ll complete surveys and join a focus group. Together, these activities are expected to take 60–75 minutes.

01

Tell us about yourself

Complete surveys about your demographics, health, and technology use.

02

Try ThriveWell

Join a 60–75 minute focus group via Zoom or in person, depending on scheduling and preferences. Access the homepage, enter initial prompts, and ask follow-up questions about the recipes.

03

Share your perspective

Share your screen while you use ThriveWell and provide feedback on your experience with the tool.

A thank-you for your time

Your contribution matters.

You will receive a $100.00 electronic gift card upon completion of the focus group and surveys.

$100electronic gift card

03 / Who can participate

Could this study
be right for you?

You must meet all of the following criteria to participate. If you have questions, the study team can help.

Ask about eligibility ↗
  • ✓
    You are 18 years of age or older.
  • ✓
    You were diagnosed with non-metastatic cancer within the last 10 years.
  • ✓
    You completed primary cancer treatment (surgery, chemotherapy, radiation) at least 3 months ago.
  • ✓
    You can access the internet and are reachable by telephone.
  • ✓
    You possess a device to use for study-related activities.
  • ✓
    You can read and write in English.
